analyst_note: Stratify by sector, hold groups together, calibrate on 2019-2020.
name: Sector-stratified group holdout, calendar window

stratify.method: within each stratum, order the assignment units by (hash bucket, unit id as text) ascending, then take the first ceil(n_units * train_below / 100) as train and the rest as calibration; a unit appearing in more than one stratum is assigned once per stratum
